svg.title: AS/RS rack front view with put-away order
svg.text: ASRS-RAW front view (one side) – put-away order of fmsctl (ORDER BY bay + level, bay, level, side) and single-cycle time
bay (crate position along the aisle, 1 = nearest the I/O; 2 crate positions per 1.925 m rack bay)
Bold number = order in which an empty rack is filled (first 40 shown). Small number = single-command cycle to that slot in s (travel 3 m/s, 0.5 m/s²;
hoist 1 m/s, 0.5 m/s²; stop 7.87 s – guide 31 data). Fastest 23.3 s (bay 1, L1), slowest 46.2 s (bay 28, L7), mean of all 392 slots 37.1 s (calculated).
